portions.purpose: Resolve Council storage and persist assessed DEFER_RUN findings.
portions.objective: Keep nonblocking review findings durable without losing the macro path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Keep review findings only in chat prose.
portions.necessity: Compaction or reviewer changes would otherwise discard accepted nonblocking work.

portions.purpose: Append validated review events only to persisted writable Council runs.
portions.objective: Preserve review lineage while enforcing READ_ONLY immutability.
portions.simpler_alternative: Let append create its own folder without checking run mode.
portions.necessity: The simpler path reproduced writes to loop.jsonl in a read-only run.

portions.purpose: Replay Council transitions, execute validations and reject read-only or invalid state changes.
portions.objective: Make the documented lifecycle enforceable before any persisted transition.
portions.simpler_alternative: Trust event order and declared command exit codes.
portions.necessity: Independent reviews reproduced both illegal transitions and fabricated evidence under that alternative.

portions.purpose: Define and inspect the installed schema and skill contract.
portions.objective: Ensure both generated runtimes contain every executable Council dependency.
portions.simpler_alternative: Check that a Council SKILL.md file exists.
portions.necessity: File existence does not prove the required operating skills or schemas are installed.

portions.purpose: Declare lifecycle states, payload schemas, quality rules and remote authority checks.
portions.objective: Prevent invented gates and unauthorized remote actions while keeping local commits automatic.
portions.simpler_alternative: Leave lifecycle and remote authority as prose conventions.
portions.necessity: Executable checks distinguish authorized push from always-authorized local commits.

portions.purpose: Validate ANCHOR, planning, slice and validation transitions.
portions.objective: Force every implementation slice through plan, tests and evidence before commit.
portions.simpler_alternative: Store independent booleans for each gate.
portions.necessity: A single transition function prevents shortcuts that independent flags cannot order.

portions.purpose: Apply review, simplification, adversarial and delivery outcomes with correction lineage.
portions.objective: Close review findings through a new planned and committed slice before delivery.
portions.simpler_alternative: Let a review verdict advance directly to delivery.
portions.necessity: The correction loop must prove changed code with a new commit and re-review.

portions.purpose: Build isolated Git scenarios and atomic commits.
portions.objective: Exercise Council behavior against real repositories instead of mocked SHA strings.
portions.simpler_alternative: Use unit-test dictionaries with fabricated commits.
portions.necessity: Repository ancestry, hooks and push behavior require real Git objects.

portions.purpose: Execute slice actions across separate processes and materialize delivery proof.
portions.objective: Prove state replay, validation-before-commit and manifest creation across process boundaries.
portions.simpler_alternative: Call runtime functions in one process.
portions.necessity: One-process tests cannot prove persisted resume and CLI integration.

portions.purpose: Run read-only, trivial authorized-push and correction-heavy journeys.
portions.objective: Verify representative START-to-GOAL paths including review loops and remote authority.
portions.simpler_alternative: Test only the happy path.
portions.necessity: The user explicitly requires read-only, compact and correction-heavy flows to remain traversable.

portions.purpose: Capture one baseline, start writable runs and keep read-only runs inline.
portions.objective: Bind execution to initial Git state without mutating audit-only work.
portions.simpler_alternative: Read HEAD only when delivery begins.
portions.necessity: Late capture cannot distinguish initial user changes from Council drift.

portions.purpose: Support strict object properties and dependent requirements in local schema validation.
portions.objective: Reject malformed Council evidence without adding a production dependency.
portions.simpler_alternative: Repeat ad-hoc field checks in each command.
portions.necessity: Central schema behavior prevents divergent payload validation.

portions.purpose: Compute evidence-bound weighted impact and the three permitted dispositions.
portions.objective: Keep reviews focused on issues that materially affect the macro goal.
portions.simpler_alternative: Let each reviewer choose a severity label.
portions.necessity: Reviewer-selected severity recreated irrelevant blockers and objective drift.

portions.purpose: Validate graph nodes, critical edges, tests and START-to-GOAL reachability.
portions.objective: Prove every critical user journey remains connected to the final delivery.
outputs: critical path and complete critical-edge set
portions.simpler_alternative: Use a linear checklist.
portions.necessity: A checklist cannot detect disconnected alternatives or missing edge-level tests.

portions.purpose: Persist nonblocking findings idempotently under the canonical RUN.md heading.
portions.objective: Defer low-impact work without losing it or blocking the active path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Mention the pending issue only in the final response.
portions.necessity: Chat-only pending items are not durable across sessions.

portions.purpose: Verify granular code-necessity ranges, source markers and nontrivial commands against Git blobs.
portions.objective: Prove every added code line has a bounded, executable semantic justification.
outputs: covered-line and verified-command counts or explicit rejection
portions.simpler_alternative: Accept whole-file prose or a successful true command.
portions.necessity: Both alternatives passed mechanically while providing no real proof.

portions.purpose: Assert operating skill markers, schemas and dual-runtime Council surfaces.
portions.objective: Prevent a skill from merely existing without being callable in the Council path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Assert one generated filename.
portions.necessity: Invocation contracts span content, schema and both runtime locations.

portions.purpose: Regress writable lifecycle, read-only zero-write and fail-closed active state.
portions.objective: Keep session anchoring safe across normal, read-only and corrupt-state flows.
portions.simpler_alternative: Inspect lifecycle code manually.
portions.necessity: Zero-write and corruption behavior require filesystem assertions.

portions.purpose: Provide deterministic graph, manifest, command and Git fixtures.
portions.objective: Test delivery integrity with consistent real-repository inputs.
portions.simpler_alternative: Duplicate fixtures in every test.
portions.necessity: Shared builders isolate the behavior under test and avoid inconsistent evidence.

portions.purpose: Regress direct read-only transition and durable planning deferrals.
portions.objective: Guarantee read-only work stays immutable while DEFER_RUN remains durable in writable runs.
portions.simpler_alternative: Rely on documentation of mutation modes.
portions.necessity: The forbidden ledger write was reproduced before this test existed.

portions.purpose: Regress append immutability, event integration and missing code-commit lineage.
portions.objective: Reject review writes and code changes that bypass the recorded Council path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Trust run folder names and manifest commit lists.
portions.necessity: Neither proves mutation mode or all code-changing ancestors.

portions.purpose: Regress merge commits, command failures, replay side effects and missing graph evidence.
portions.objective: Ensure delivery proof is reproducible, clean and backed by material files.
portions.simpler_alternative: Only reject commands with nonzero exit codes.
portions.necessity: A zero-exit command created untracked drift, and a missing evidence file still passed.

portions.purpose: Regress complete CLI materialization, critical branches, test IDs and invalid ledger transitions.
portions.objective: Prove the public delivery command enforces graph, tests and repository state together.
portions.simpler_alternative: Call internal validators independently.
portions.necessity: The installed command is the user-facing composition point and needs end-to-end proof.

portions.purpose: Regress fabricated commits and consumption of the real transition ledger by delivery.
portions.objective: Bind Council CLI writes to the exact evidence later replayed at delivery.
portions.simpler_alternative: Use separate synthetic ledgers for transition and delivery tests.
portions.necessity: Separate ledgers would not prove the documented producer-consumer path.

portions.purpose: Define transition fixtures and regress the core execution sequence and illegal shortcuts.
portions.objective: Make planning, slice, validation and local commit ordering deterministic.
portions.simpler_alternative: One end-to-end scenario only.
portions.necessity: Focused transition failures provide precise diagnostics and cheap regression.

portions.purpose: Regress correction loops, reviewer identity, fresh commits and terminal review states.
portions.objective: Prevent stale proof or self-review from satisfying the final gate.
portions.simpler_alternative: Trust reviewer prose and reuse prior commits.
portions.necessity: The user requires each correction to be planned, validated, committed and re-reviewed.

portions.purpose: Regress remote authority, weighted review deferrals and graph-bound test IDs.
portions.objective: Advance nonblocking work while preserving authority and acceptance integrity.
portions.simpler_alternative: Treat every finding as blocking and every test label as trusted.
portions.necessity: That alternative recreates the exact overblocking and fabricated-gate problem being solved.

portions.purpose: Regress impact scoring, graph reachability and idempotent deferral.
portions.objective: Keep the macro north measurable and every critical branch test-bound.
portions.simpler_alternative: Verify only a representative score.
portions.necessity: Boundary, override, disconnected graph and duplicate deferral cases fail differently.

portions.purpose: Regress SHA binding, source evidence, no-op rejection, precise ranges and stale receipts.
portions.objective: Guarantee the final code report proves rather than asserts necessity.
outputs: positive coverage and negative integrity verdicts
portions.simpler_alternative: Check only that every added line number appears in some range.
portions.necessity: Mechanical coverage accepted whole files, missing objectives and true commands.

portions.purpose: Load shared state helpers, safe evidence files, code commits and validation commands.
portions.objective: Prepare delivery proof from canonical repository and Council primitives without duplication.
portions.simpler_alternative: Duplicate worktree logic and inspect first-parent diffs only.
portions.necessity: The duplicate drifted, and first-parent-only detection missed merge-resolution code.

portions.purpose: Replay ordered events and verify SHA, commits, hashes and worktree before and after commands.
portions.objective: Accept only a reproducible delivery that leaves repository state unchanged.
portions.simpler_alternative: Check worktree only before replay.
portions.necessity: A successful touch command then left untracked drift without detection.

portions.purpose: Cross-check manifest, graph evidence, code receipts, acceptance, reviewers, edges and tests.
portions.objective: Bind final delivery to every planned critical edge and committed slice.
portions.simpler_alternative: Validate schemas without resolving referenced evidence.
portions.necessity: A schema-valid graph pointed to a nonexistent delivery artifact and still passed.

portions.purpose: Include every governing and review skill in Codex parity checks.
portions.objective: Keep the Codex-only generated runtime on the same Council path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Test only the Council wrapper.
portions.necessity: A wrapper can reference skills that were never rendered.

portions.purpose: Regress EN lifecycle vocabulary and the integrated incremental, authority and objective contracts.
portions.objective: Prevent language or template merge drift from making documented commands invalid.
inputs: PT and EN Council template sources
portions.simpler_alternative: Snapshot the full rendered Markdown.
portions.necessity: Focused markers localize contract drift such as APPLY versus APLICAR.

portions.purpose: Render one real Orion project and execute all installed Council suites.
portions.objective: Prove source-template changes survive Copier and work in the delivered runtime.
outputs: installed objective, runtime, pipeline, contract and evaluation verdicts
portions.simpler_alternative: Run tests only against template source paths.
portions.necessity: Source-only execution previously hid render and installation failures.

portions.purpose: Assert all operating skills materialize in Claude-only, Codex-only and dual-runtime renders.
portions.objective: Deliver the same Council behavior in every supported runtime and language path.
portions.simpler_alternative: Compare only source Jinja files.
portions.necessity: Conditional paths and locale selectors are observable only in actual renders.
